name: campusconnect
description: CampusConnect — placement-drive hub with RBAC, job listings, deadline reminders, application tracking and prep tracker

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n mongo,server,client -c yellow,blue,green "node scripts/start-mongo.js" "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix server && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix server && npm run typecheck --prefix client
